misconceptions.description: Multiplies by the percentage number but does not divide by 100.
misconceptions.short_fix: Convert the percent to a fraction over 100 before multiplying.

misconceptions.description: Adds the percentage part to the original amount when the question asks for the part alone.
misconceptions.short_fix: Check whether the task asks for the percentage amount or the updated total.

misconceptions.description: Uses the complementary percentage when asked for the percentage amount itself.
misconceptions.short_fix: Identify whether the question asks for the part, the remaining part, or the new total.

misconceptions.description: Calculates the profit or loss percentage using selling price rather than cost price.
misconceptions.short_fix: Profit and loss percentages use cost price as their base.

misconceptions.description: Adds a loss or subtracts a profit when calculating selling price.
misconceptions.short_fix: Profit increases selling price above cost; loss decreases it below cost.

misconceptions.description: Reports the profit or loss amount instead of the requested selling price.
misconceptions.short_fix: Combine the change amount with the cost price to find selling price.

misconceptions.description: Calculates one period of interest and ignores the number of years.
misconceptions.short_fix: Multiply the annual interest by the full time in years.

misconceptions.description: Uses the rate as a whole number without converting percent to a fraction.
misconceptions.short_fix: Divide the rate by 100 in the PRT/100 formula.

misconceptions.description: Applies a changing balance even though the question specifies simple interest.
misconceptions.short_fix: Simple interest is calculated on the original principal each period.

misconceptions.description: Adds the same interest amount each year instead of compounding.
misconceptions.short_fix: Apply the growth factor to the current amount after every period.

misconceptions.description: Reports the final amount rather than subtracting the original principal to get interest.
misconceptions.short_fix: Compound interest equals final amount minus principal.

misconceptions.description: Applies the growth factor too few or too many times.
misconceptions.short_fix: Apply one growth factor for each completed compounding period.

misconceptions.description: Uses a ratio term as if it were the whole number of parts.
misconceptions.short_fix: Add all ratio terms to find the total equal parts.

misconceptions.description: Assigns the share for one ratio term to the other quantity.
misconceptions.short_fix: Keep the order of quantities aligned with the order of ratio terms.

misconceptions.description: Finds one share but does not verify that all shares add to the given total.
misconceptions.short_fix: Check that the divided shares sum to the original total.

misconceptions.description: Reports the total when the question asks for the arithmetic mean.
misconceptions.short_fix: Divide the total by the number of observations to get the mean.

misconceptions.description: Divides by the wrong number of observations.
misconceptions.short_fix: Count every included value once, including a missing value being solved for.

misconceptions.description: Adds the known values to the required total instead of subtracting them.
misconceptions.short_fix: Find the required full total first, then subtract the known values.

misconceptions.description: Averages concentrations without weighting by the amount of each solution.
misconceptions.short_fix: Multiply each concentration by its quantity before dividing by total quantity.

misconceptions.description: Pairs each ingredient with its own distance from the target instead of the opposite difference.
misconceptions.short_fix: For low and high strengths, use high-minus-target for low-strength quantity and target-minus-low for high-strength quantity.

misconceptions.description: Confuses the concentration value with the amount of solution needed.
misconceptions.short_fix: Use the target concentration to derive a quantity ratio, then apply the ratio to the total.

misconceptions.description: Divides profit only by invested capitals even though partners invested for different durations.
misconceptions.short_fix: Use capital multiplied by time for each partner.

misconceptions.description: Divides profit only by time and ignores how much capital each partner invested.
misconceptions.short_fix: Compare each partner’s capital-time product.

misconceptions.description: Assigns a profit share to the wrong partner after forming the capital-time ratio.
misconceptions.short_fix: Keep each capital-time product attached to its partner when dividing profit.

misconceptions.description: Adds completion times instead of adding work rates.
misconceptions.short_fix: Convert each completion time into a rate of work per day, then add rates.

misconceptions.description: Uses days per job as if it were jobs or units per day.
misconceptions.short_fix: Rate is work divided by time; with one job, a d-day worker completes 1/d per day.

misconceptions.description: Combines rates that use different units for the total job.
misconceptions.short_fix: Choose one common work total divisible by each completion time.

misconceptions.description: Treats negative even integers as odd because the number is below zero.
misconceptions.short_fix: Divisibility by 2 determines parity for negative numbers too.

misconceptions.description: Omits an even endpoint while counting an inclusive integer interval.
misconceptions.short_fix: Check both endpoints and include them when they meet the condition.

misconceptions.description: Treats zero as odd or excludes it from the even integers.
misconceptions.short_fix: Zero is even because it is divisible by 2.

misconceptions.description: Integer interval count arithmetic was miscalculated.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recheck the first and last eligible integers and count by twos.

misconceptions.description: The final multiplication or division for a percentage was miscalculated.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recheck the multiplication and divide by 100 exactly once.

misconceptions.description: The profit or loss calculation contains an arithmetic slip.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recompute the percentage amount, then check the addition or subtraction.

misconceptions.description: The simple-interest calculation contains an arithmetic slip.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recheck principal × rate × time, then divide by 100.

misconceptions.description: The compound-interest calculation contains an arithmetic slip.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recheck each growth period and subtract the starting principal.

misconceptions.description: The ratio-share arithmetic contains a calculation slip.
misconceptions.short_fix: Check the total number of parts and the resulting share.

misconceptions.description: The mean calculation contains an arithmetic slip.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recheck the total and divide by the correct count.

misconceptions.description: The weighted mixture calculation contains an arithmetic slip.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recheck each concentration-times-quantity product and the total quantity.

misconceptions.description: The capital-time share arithmetic contains a calculation slip.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recheck each capital-time product and the profit split.

misconceptions.description: The combined work-rate arithmetic contains a calculation slip.
misconceptions.short_fix: Recheck each worker’s rate in the same work units before adding.
